title.zh: 雨夜便利店街角 · 微缩 3D 街景

one_liner.zh: 一个 945 KB 的单文件 HTML：断网可开、零 UI、三渲二硬边，一座可以自由旋转缩放的雨夜便利店街角微缩模型。
one_liner.en: A 945 KB single-file HTML: offline-capable, zero UI, hard-edged cel shading — a rotatable miniature of a rainy-night convenience-store corner.

status.type: 3D 场景 / 生成式提示词资产
status.state: 已完成并通过 20 轮外部评审

q1_problem.zh: 难的不是「搭一个 3D 场景」，而是让一座微缩模型**看着像缩微模型而不是实景**，并且把「哪盏灯该亮、货架排面该多密」这类只能靠眼睛调的参数，写成别人能照抄的提示词。前者是渲染判断，后者是知识固化——两者都没有现成答案。
q1_problem.en: The hard part is not building a 3D scene, but making a miniature read AS a miniature rather than a life-size street, and then writing down lamp brightness and shelf density — parameters that can only be tuned by eye — as a prompt others can copy. The first is a rendering judgement, the second is knowledge capture.

q2_scenarios.zh: 零成本验证一座街景的美学方向
q2_scenarios.en: Validate a street's aesthetic direction at zero cost

q2_scenarios.after: 改提示词一行，刷新浏览器，两秒看到结果

q2_scenarios.zh: 把「只能意会」的微缩感固化成可移交规格
q2_scenarios.en: Turn 'you know it when you see it' miniaturisation into a transferable spec
q2_scenarios.before: 调完即忘，下次从头试错
q2_scenarios.after: 77 条分级条款（Invariant / Recipe / Implementation），附源码出处表

q2_minimal_path.zh: 下载 dist/rainy-night-konbini.html → 双击打开 → 左键拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、右键平移

q3_architecture.zh: 七段源码 → build.py 拼接 → 单文件产物。three.js r128 整段内联，产物自带诊断桥供探针测量场景。
q3_architecture.en: Seven source chunks → build.py concatenation → single-file artifact. three.js r128 fully inlined; the artifact exposes a diagnostic bridge so probes can measure the scene.
